## Review checklist
- [ ] Source specs checked; no assumptions silently turned into requirements
- [ ] Changes are limited to the approved task
- [ ] Required tests added and actually executed
- [ ] Error/negative cases covered
- [ ] Auth, data safety and secrets considered
- [ ] Documentation and traceability updated
- [ ] No unresolved P0/P1 findings
- [ ] Ready for **human** review (no automatic merge)
